text.en:
Currency Act
(Chapter 69)
Pursuant to section 17(5) of the Currency Act, it is hereby notified for general information that the denominations and characteristics of the coins to be issued on 20th August 2009 by the Monetary Authority of Singapore are as shown in the Schedule.

THE SCHEDULE
DESCRIPTION OF THE 2009 HERITAGE ORCHIDS OF SINGAPORE COINS TO BE ISSUED ON 20TH AUGUST 2009

Milled and bearing the words “MONETARY AUTHORITY OF SINGAPORE” and lion symbol.
The Singapore Arms in the centre with the year-date “2009” below it and the word “SINGAPORE” in the 4 official languages around the circumference of the coin. The position of the mintmark is at 5 o’clock of the coin.
The coin design features the orchid “Vanda Amy” in full colour at the centre of the coin with the name of the orchid along the upper circumference. The weight in grams and fineness of the coin are at the lower circumference. The denomination is at the upper-left of the coin.

The coin design features the orchid “Spathoglottis Primrose” in full colour towards the left of the coin with the name of the orchid along the upper circumference. The weight in grams and fineness of the coin are at the lower circumference. The denomination is at the right of the coin.
(a) Reverse Design of the $5 Silver Proof Coin (Vanda Amy).
(b) Reverse Design of the $5 Silver Proof Coin (Spathoglottis Primrose).
(c) Common Obverse Design for $5 Silver Proof Coins (Vanda Amy and Spathoglottis Primrose).
